title: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan
wikitext:
[[image:DagranThaurissan.jpg|thumb|Emperor Dagran Thaurissan]]
'''Emperor Dagran Thaurissan''' is the current ruler of the [[Dark Iron Clan]], a descendant of Emperor [[Thaurissan]] and [[Modgud]]. Even as the leader of his clan, he is like all Dark Irons a slave of [[Ragnaros]].

He was married to King [[Magni Bronzebeard]]'s daughter, Princess [[Moira Bronzebeard]], and she is pregnant with his child, one who stand to inherit the throne of [[Ironforge]].  While it was believed that the Princess' affection for Tharissan was the result of a spell, she remains steadfast in her loyalty even following Thaurissan's death.
